scope: Fresh inspection of exact pinned vendor source; no upstream comparison
established: Beacon DMA completion unmaps the ring-owned mapping and clears its ring packet reference under BcnRingLock. It advances WRITE_TO_DMA to DMA_DONE, not IDLE.
BcnTxSHandler independently sets IDLE; its original timestamp and sequence accesses are DBG-only telemetry, not a validated reservation comparison.
TYPE1 PID reservation is allocated in long TXD construction before host status is enabled. Clearing only the host-status bit would strand the reservation.
next_implementation_constraints: Any non-owning beacon-status mode must skip reservation allocation before descriptor publication and define separate pacing; changing DMA_DONE to IDLE alone is insufficient.
Sequence presence in a debug report does not establish that software assigned the corresponding descriptor sequence. Trace assignment and wrap before using it as correlation.
Preserve existing DMA completion owner, ACK protection, Main/Guest and radio timing. Keep owner release fenced until the replacement lifecycle is verified.
scratch: Source read directly from existing preservation archive; no extraction or additional archive retained.

sequence_constructor_inspection.conclusion: Current beacon constructor does not establish a host-assigned TXD sequence cookie. The returned TxS SN cannot safely be compared with a new software generation without an additional verified descriptor policy.
